entries.note: The first row, without a terminal and with PICK UP in the column other rows give a manifest number: the pickup on the bill, before the row that says it was made.
Picked up from the shipper, at the terminal that collected it.
A transfer from one terminal to another; the row names both.
On the delivering terminal's truck, spelled so.
Its row can give the driver's clock in and out at the consignee, and who signed.
